title: Voice & realtime
description: Governed voice and realtime sessions across the estate. The console shows references and aggregates only — never audio, transcription text, prompts or PII.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Each session as the engine reports it — state is derived at read-time. The transcript is shown only as a fingerprint; there is no audio or text behind it.
sessions.emptyHint: Sessions appear once a governed open is dispatched against a voice policy.

latency.title: Latency by session
latency.description: Average response latency per session, ranked. The table carries the max alongside — no p50/p95 is shown without per-turn samples.
latency.summary: Average response latency for {{count}} sessions, ranked. The slowest is {{session}} at {{latency}}.
latency.summaryEmpty: No sessions to rank by latency.

honesty.noContent: References and aggregates only — no audio, transcription text, prompts or PII are exposed here.
honesty.findingsNote: Policy violations, latency degradation and ungoverned opens surface through the Security findings plane, not these routes.

policies.title: Voice policies
policies.description: Default-DENY: a policy is what PERMITS opening a session. With no matching policy, an open is denied.
policies.emptyHint: Define a policy to permit opening voice sessions for an agent — default-deny means nothing opens until one matches.

dialog.title: Voice policy
dialog.description: This policy PERMITS opening sessions for the matching agent (default-deny). Use '*' to match all agents, models or providers.
dialog.agentHint: An agent reference, or '*' for every agent.
dialog.modelHint: A model reference, or '*' for any model.
dialog.providerHint: A provider reference, or '*' for any provider.

latencyByCategoryChart.title: No session latency to rank yet
latencyByCategoryChart.description: Average response latency can be ranked once a governed open or realtime telemetry creates a voice session record.

policies.title: No voice policies defined yet
policies.description: A policy permits matching agent, model and provider opens; without one, every voice session open is denied. Setting one is admin-tier.

sessions.title: No voice sessions observed yet
sessions.description: Sessions appear after a governed open is recorded or the configured realtime observer publishes session telemetry.

surface.chooseSession: Choose a session to see its live surface.
surface.decisionsError: The decisions could not be read.
surface.noDecisions: No decisions recorded for this session.

outcome.approval: Approval requested — re-send with this approval reference:
outcome.denied: Denied by policy: no voice policy permits this (agent, model, provider). This is a default-deny decision, not a failure.
outcome.noGate: No approval gate is wired in this deployment, so the open stays denied. This is an estate gap, not a policy denial.
outcome.unavailable: The approval gate did not answer, so nothing was decided.

ledger.title: Open decision ledger
ledger.description: Every decision to open a voice session across the estate, append-only and newest first — including the ones that were DENIED and therefore never became a session.
ledger.caveat: A denied open does not create a session row of its own, so this is the first dedicated view that shows it in full with only `voice:session:read`. Other paths show it partially or need another permission: the API playground (tenant admin), the audit explorer (the action, without its reason) and Security findings (some paths only).
ledger.emptyHint: This records the decisions the engine managed to persist. The evidence write is best-effort by design — a denial stands even if its ledger row is lost — so an empty ledger is not proof that nothing was refused.
ledger.truncated: Showing the most recent {{count}} decisions and the engine reports more: this list is TRUNCATED. Read it as a sample, not as the whole ledger.
